description: A motion graphic written as code (a Canvas 2D draw function run per frame in Clypmint's sandbox): charts, maps, labels, anything drawn. Read get_guide graphics first. Text only from slots (d.slots.name), the same frame for the same t, fonts from get_font_family_info, a new name each time. Saved on its own; preview_at looks first without saving. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: The version_id you read; refused if the video changed since.

code.description: JavaScript defining function draw(ctx, t, d, s) and optionally setup(d).

end.description: Film second it ends; at most 30 s after start.

name.description: A new short name (the id is made from it).

operation_id.description: A retry with the same id runs once.

output_id.description: An output (Short, hook, shape); the main video when left out.

preview_at.description: Film seconds to look at it, unsaved.

replaces.description: Graphics this one redoes (layer ids), hidden while it plays.

slots.description: Words and numbers the code reads as d.slots (editable later).

name: write_graphic

outputSchema.description: Clypmint write_graphic result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Write a motion graphic
